data.narrative:
Outpost Space is a seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Jason Dunn that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation universe includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($40M) as a proxy for valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $100M. This method is suitable given the company's capital intensity and early stage, where follow-on funding multiples offer a reasonable anchor. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which private companies typically do not release. A peer-median approach was also inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow space & aerospace cohort meeting minimum sample thresholds (0 vs. 3+ required).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with a median point of $100M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data for public-comp validation, the thinness of same-stage private peer precedents, and unknowns around burn rate, technical de-risking, and near-term funding trajectory. A follow-on method after next funding event or revenue disclosure would materially strengthen conviction in any final valuation.
